gripOrHq.title: Loan from Chiba
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [12] when Loan from Chiba is installed. At the start of each of your turns, lose [1]. If Loan from Chiba leaves play, pay [10] or lose the game. You may trash Loan from Chiba at the end of any of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Blink
gripOrHq.rulesText:
[0]: Roll a die. On a 4, 5, or 6, break ice subroutine; otherwise, suffer that much Net damage.
Use this ability only once on each subroutine during each encounter with a piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Armored Fridge
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
Put seven Ablative counters on Armored Fridge when it is installed. When the last Ablative counter has been removed, trash Armored Fridge.
Ablative counter: Prevent 1 meat damage.

heapOrArchives.title: Broker
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

heapOrArchives.title: Inside Job
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

heapOrArchives.title: Armored Fridge
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
Put seven Ablative counters on Armored Fridge when it is installed. When the last Ablative counter has been removed, trash Armored Fridge.
Ablative counter: Prevent 1 meat damage.

heapOrArchives.title: Top Runners' Conference
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

heapOrArchives.title: Social Engineering
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Hide at least 2 from your pool in your hand; the Corp then guesses how many bits you hid. If the Corp guesses correctly, lose that many bits. Otherwise, choose a data fort and a piece of ice on that fort. Then make a run on that fort, during which you automatically pass that piece of ice.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

scoreArea.title: Priority Requisition
scoreArea.rulesText: You may rez a piece of ice, at no cost, when you score Priority Requisition.

scoreArea.title: Private Cybernet Police
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

Use this ability only once on each subroutine during each encounter with a piece of ice.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

rig.title: Wilson, Weeflerunner Apprentice
rig.rulesText:
Each of your turns, you may choose to gain an action, which you may use only to make a run. You cannot spend more than [3] during that run to pay for using icebreakers or increasing your link. Use this ability only once per turn and only during your turn.
[T]: Avoid receiving a tag.
[T]: Prevent any amount of meat damage.

root.title: Antiquated Interface Routines
root.rulesText: All ice on this fort has +1 strength.

root.title: Tokyo-Chiba Infighting
root.rulesText:
Gain [2] after each unsuccessful run on this fort.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: Euromarket Consortium
root.rulesText: Hand size +2; A, [1]: Draw two cards.

root.title: Experimental AI
root.rulesText: You may advance Experimental AI before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Experimental AI, trash one program for each advancement counter on it.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.

ice.title: Shock.r
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.
